overview: EGameCharacterActionType identifies the animation and gameplay state requests that a character action controller can run.

None.technical: The zero sentinel is the header default and the domain-expansion gate checks it before ChangeAction. ResolveFollowUpAttackType returns None when no attack transition passes, and the auto-combo path treats None as a failed follow-up.
notes: DomainExpansion rows use None to leave the target action unchanged.

Default.technical: FGameCharacterAction_Default reports the Default layer, and CreateAction builds it for this type. GetLayerDefaultAction returns it for layers outside Attack and Damage, and PlaySequenceAnimation uses the owner sequence action name.

DefaultEmpty.simple: An inert Default-layer action for controlled characters.
DefaultEmpty.technical: Control type 5 selects DefaultEmpty as the controller Default-layer default. The class reports the Default layer and its own action type without adding animations or request handling.

DefaultIdle.simple: The idle fallback that restores the Default layer.
DefaultIdle.technical: ChangeToDefaultActions requests DefaultIdle with an ignored-priority action request. Its Start plays the shared idle animation, and the class derives from FGameCharacterAction_Default.

Idle.simple: The character stands still on the ground.
Idle.technical: GetDefaultMoveActionType returns Idle when the ground trace hits, and the controller passes Idle as the normal initial Default-layer action. FGameCharacterAction_Idle reports priority 0 and requests its default move action after its animation ends.

RunBegin.simple: The character starts running and turns toward the input.
RunBegin.technical: The controller accepts RunBegin from a left-stick input beyond the 0.5 dead zone. Start sets move mode 2 and copies Run_Rotation_Time in seconds from the current ActionMove row into RotationTimer, and Tick advances Phase when the stick is released or the timer expires.

Run.simple: The character keeps running while movement input is held.
Run.technical: Run sets move mode 3 and a virtual-camera distance request on Start, then requests the default move action after the stick is released. Later actions inherit Run inertia from ActionMove fields Run_Inertia_Rate and Run_Inertia_Time.

NormalDashBegin.simple: The character starts a ground dash.
NormalDashBegin.technical: The controller accepts a Dash press when CanDash(7) succeeds. ConsumeDashGaugeBegin charges Dash_GaugeConsumeBegin scaled by GetDashGaugeConsumeRate, and the shared begin path plays the dash animation with camera-distance and yaw-slack setup.

NormalDash.simple: The character keeps dashing along the ground.
NormalDash.technical: ConsumeDashGauge subtracts NormalDash_GaugeConsume each second, scaled by GetNormalDashGaugeConsumeRate. The loop uses GetMinimumTime and the held Dash input to decide whether the dash continues, and later actions inherit NormalDash inertia.

NormalDashEnd.simple: The character finishes a ground dash.
NormalDashEnd.technical: The dash-end animation flag drives UpdateRequests, which falls back to Fall when the grounded flag fails and otherwise requests the default move action. GActionCancelTable uses this type as a key for grounded follow-up moves and attacks.

NormalDashAirBegin.simple: The character starts an air dash.
NormalDashAirBegin.technical: The controller accepts a Dash press when CanDash(10) succeeds. ConsumeDashGaugeBegin charges DashAir_GaugeConsumeBegin, and the shared air-begin path sets the air move mode and begins the gauge cost after a fixed animation phase.

NormalDashAir.simple: The character keeps dashing through the air.
NormalDashAir.technical: ConsumeDashGauge subtracts NormalDashAir_GaugeConsume each second, scaled by GetDashAirGaugeConsumeRate. The loop sets move mode 7, and later actions inherit NormalDashAir inertia.

NormalDashAirEnd.simple: The character finishes a normal air dash.
NormalDashAirEnd.technical: After the end animation flag is set, UpdateRequests requests GetDashAirEndNextActionType. The base controller returns Fall for that getter.

HomingDashAirBegin.simple: The character starts a homing air dash.
HomingDashAirBegin.technical: The controller accepts a Dash press when CanDash(13) succeeds and the left stick has no input. ConsumeDashGaugeBegin charges HomingDashAir_GaugeConsumeBegin, and the begin action can cancel a tag-combo damage action through its slot 83 check.

HomingDashAir.simple: The character homes toward a target during an air dash.
HomingDashAir.technical: Tick refreshes the movement warp location before the shared dash loop runs. The loop uses HomingDashAir_GaugeConsume per second, move mode 11, and a secondary target distance beyond the capsule radius plus one world unit.

HomingDashAirEnd.simple: The character finishes a homing air dash.
HomingDashAirEnd.technical: After the end animation flag is set, UpdateRequests requests GetDashAirEndNextActionType and then the default move action. The base controller returns Fall for the first request.

AutoAttackDashAirBegin.simple: The character starts an automatic approach dash.
AutoAttackDashAirBegin.technical: The controller accepts a normal-attack press when CanAutoAttackDash succeeds and no attack is active. The begin path charges HomingDashAir_GaugeConsumeBegin, sets the target as secondary target, and computes a warp location bounded by AutoAttackDash_Distance in world units.

AutoAttackDashAir.simple: The character flies toward the auto-attack target.
AutoAttackDashAir.technical: Tick clamps the warp distance to AutoAttackDash_Distance and stops the two capsule radii short of the target. UpdateRequests requests AutoAttackDashAirEnd at the warp endpoint, then the character row AutoAttackDash_NextActionType and the default move action.
notes: Exported character rows use NormalAttackAir_1, NormalAttackAir_2, and NormalAttackAir_3_1 for AutoAttackDash_NextActionType.

AutoAttackDashAirEnd.simple: The character finishes an automatic approach dash.
AutoAttackDashAirEnd.technical: CreateAction builds FGameCharacterAction_AutoAttackDashAirEnd, which inherits HomingDashAirEnd request handling. That handler requests Fall and then the default move action after the end animation.

Guard.simple: The character guards a hit while grounded.
Guard.technical: GetGuardActionType selects Guard when the owner is not in an air action, and the controller accepts the Guard key as a held input. The action reports priority 1, tracks RestraintTimer, and resolves guarded hits through OnGuardHit.

GuardAir.simple: The character guards a hit while airborne.
GuardAir.technical: GetGuardActionType selects GuardAir when the owner is in an air action. The air class sets its air-state flag, uses air guard montages, and calls SetUnknown5E8 on Start.

JustGuard.simple: The character parries a well-timed grounded hit.
JustGuard.technical: GameBattleDamage requests the controller JustGuard type when the receiver is inside the just-guard window and the hit lacks flag 9. The action reports priority 1 and plays the ground parry montage.

JustGuardAir.simple: The character parries a well-timed airborne hit.
JustGuardAir.technical: GetJustGuardActionType returns JustGuardAir when the receiver is in an air action. The class keeps the just-guard timing and uses its own parry montage.

GuardBreak.simple: The character loses guard on the ground.
GuardBreak.technical: GameBattleDamage requests GetGuardBreakActionType when guard durability reaches zero. The ground variant derives from the damage-reaction family and reports priority 100.

GuardBreakAir.simple: The character loses guard while airborne.
GuardBreakAir.technical: GetGuardBreakActionType returns GuardBreakAir when the receiver is in an air action. The class inherits the guard-break reaction and sets its air-state flag.

Step.simple: The character sidesteps on the ground.
Step.technical: The controller accepts Step while Guard is held and any left-stick direction flick is active. Start maps the input against the camera view to StepDirection values 0 through 3, which select the matching Step montages.

StepAir.technical: The controller accepts the same Guard plus stick-flick input for StepAir. The class derives from Step and sets its air-state flag.

JumpBegin.simple: The character crouches and prepares a standing jump.
JumpBegin.technical: The controller accepts JumpBegin from a Jump press with no left-stick input beyond the 0.5 dead zone. The begin action plays a rigidity-scaled animation and requests Jump when that animation ends.

Jump.simple: The character rises and falls after a standing jump.
Jump.technical: JumpBegin requests this type. The rise and fall tick switches to the jump fall move mode at vertical speed zero, and jump inertia comes from Jump_Inertia_Rate and Jump_Inertia_Time.

RunJumpBegin.simple: The character prepares a jump from a running start.
RunJumpBegin.technical: The controller accepts RunJumpBegin from a Jump press while the left stick is beyond the 0.5 dead zone. The begin action plays its own animation and requests RunJump.

RunJump.simple: The character rises and falls after a running jump.
RunJump.technical: RunJumpBegin requests this type. The rise and fall logic uses the jump row, and later actions inherit RunJump inertia from RunJump_Inertia_Rate and RunJump_Inertia_Time.

DashJumpBegin.simple: The character prepares a jump from a dash.
DashJumpBegin.technical: The controller accepts DashJumpBegin from a Jump press. The begin action plays its own animation and requests DashJump.

DashJump.simple: The character rises and falls after a dash jump.
DashJump.technical: DashJumpBegin requests this type. The rise and fall logic uses the jump row, and later actions inherit DashJump inertia from DashJump_Inertia_Rate and DashJump_Inertia_Time.

JumpAirBegin.simple: The character prepares a midair jump.
JumpAirBegin.technical: The controller accepts JumpAirBegin from a Jump press with no left-stick input. On action end, OnActionEnded increments its ActionStartCounts entry and also increments RunJumpAirBegin, and CanAirJump compares the JumpAirBegin count with GetAirJumpLimit.

JumpAir.simple: The character performs a midair jump.
JumpAir.technical: JumpAirBegin requests this type. The air update path keeps request processing active during the rise and fall phases, and later actions inherit JumpAir inertia.

RunJumpAirBegin.simple: The character prepares a midair jump while moving.
RunJumpAirBegin.technical: The controller accepts RunJumpAirBegin from a Jump press while the left stick is beyond the 0.5 dead zone. On action end it increments its own count and the JumpAirBegin count, feeding the shared air-jump limit.

RunJumpAir.simple: The character performs a midair jump while moving.
RunJumpAir.technical: RunJumpAirBegin requests this type. It shares the air rise and fall behavior and uses RunJumpAir inertia on the following action.

SuperCursedEnergyAttackEnd.simple: The character settles after a super cursed-energy attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttackEnd.technical: Start plays the SuperCursedEnergyAttackEnd montage, and Tick sets Byte16 when playback finishes. UpdateRequests then requests the controller default move action.

TagComboEnd.simple: The character settles after a tag combo.
TagComboEnd.technical: The class derives from SuperCursedEnergyAttackEnd and reuses its Tick and request handling. Start plays the TagComboEnd montage, then the default move action is requested after playback.

Fall.simple: The character falls through the air.
Fall.technical: GetDefaultMoveActionType returns Fall when the ground trace misses. Start sets move mode 34 and uses move mode 33 after a request hover time in seconds expires, and the landing request reads GetLandingActionType.
notes: The source names the hover timer Request.AnimationTime and uses it as a duration in seconds.

Landing.simple: The character lands from a short fall.
Landing.technical: GetLandingActionType computes this from Landing by adding one when accumulated vertical travel is below 1000.0 world units. Landing plays the normal landing animation, triggers the landing effect, and scales inertia with Landing_Inertia_Rate and Landing_Inertia_RateZ.

LandingLarge.simple: The character lands hard from a long fall.
LandingLarge.technical: GetLandingActionType returns this type when accumulated vertical travel reaches 1000.0 world units by adding one to the Landing enum value. It shares landing effects and inertia scaling and uses the Landing_02 animation.

BreakFall.simple: The character recovers in midair after a launch.
BreakFall.technical: The controller accepts BreakFall from a Jump press. Start plays BlowRecoverBegin and resets inertia, End grants collision lock 6 invincibility for the ActionBreakFall row Invincible_Time, and UpdateRequests requests Fall.

Floating.simple: The character holds a floating airborne idle.
Floating.technical: CP_050 and CP_051 create character-specific floating actions for this type and request them while Byte16 is clear, Phase is 1, and Jump is held. OnActionEnded increments its ActionStartCounts entry, and OnGrounded later removes that count.
notes: The base CreateAction switch has no Floating case. CP_050 and CP_051 supply the object in their overrides.

BoogieWoogieReceive.simple: The character receives a friendly position swap on the ground.
BoogieWoogieReceive.technical: OnPlaceSwap requests this type for a same-team swap when the owner is not in an air action. Start plays BoogieWoogieReceive, attaches FX_CP_000_16001, finishes effects D8, resets inertia, and requests the default move action after playback.

BoogieWoogieReceiveAir.simple: The character receives a friendly position swap in the air.
BoogieWoogieReceiveAir.technical: OnPlaceSwap requests this type for a same-team swap when the owner is in an air action. The class derives from the ground receive action and sets its air-state flag.

AttackDefault.simple: The neutral state for the attack layer.
AttackDefault.technical: The controller selects AttackDefault for the Attack layer on normal characters and ChangeToDefaultActions returns to it. When it starts, OnActionStarted clears all 36 attack start counts, resets the attack voice timer, and clears the attack-change flag.

AttackEmpty.simple: An inert Attack-layer action for controlled characters.
AttackEmpty.technical: Control type 5 selects AttackEmpty for the controller Attack-layer default. The class reports the Attack layer and its own action type without adding attack logic.

NormalAttack_1.simple: The character performs the ground combo opening in the sequence.
NormalAttack_1.technical: Ground combo opening. It resolves its AttackSet row from Id_AttackSet_Normal_1 and uses attack index 1 in GAttackActionIndexMap. Its ground-to-air map entry resolves to the matching airborne attack. Start counts for this exact action are recorded in ActionStartCounts and cleared when AttackDefault starts. Direct input uses the matching normal-attack key, with the branch chosen by forward stick direction.

NormalAttack_1_Auto.simple: The character performs the ground auto-combo opening in the sequence.
NormalAttack_1_Auto.technical: Ground auto-combo opening. It resolves its AttackSet row from Id_AttackSet_Normal_1_Auto and uses attack index 2 in GAttackActionIndexMap. Its ground-to-air map entry resolves to the matching airborne attack. ResolveFollowUpAttackType uses GAttackActionIndexMap to select auto-combo follow-ups by transition kind. The auto variant is reached through auto-combo resolution.

NormalAttack_1_1.technical: Ground combo branch. It resolves its AttackSet row from Id_AttackSet_Normal_1_1 and uses attack index 3 in GAttackActionIndexMap. Its AttackSet row can switch to the solo variant through slot 146. Direct input uses the matching normal-attack key, with the branch chosen by forward stick direction.

CursedEnergyAttack_1.simple: The character uses the ground first cursed-energy attack.
CursedEnergyAttack_1.technical: The ground first cursed-energy attack resolves Id_AttackSet_CursedEnergy_1 by cursed-energy level, with level from CursedEnergyLevel minus one and index three on the battle finish target. It uses attack index 13 in GAttackActionIndexMap and refuses a follow-up when the next row cost would take cursed energy below zero.

It uses attack index 14 in GAttackActionIndexMap and refuses a follow-up when the next row cost would take cursed energy below zero. The auto variant uses the owner auto-combo damage rate and its own attack-set row.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack.simple: The character unleashes a super cursed-energy attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack.technical: The ground super attack needs Guard held with CursedEnergyAttack_2 pressed, IsCursedEnergyTechniqueEnabled(false) true, and a receiver that is not the battle finish target. It resolves Id_AttackSet_SuperCursedEnergy, uses attack index 17 in GAttackActionIndexMap, and plays attack effect FX_CP_000_23141.

It resolves Id_AttackSet_SuperCursedEnergy_Air, uses attack index 17 in GAttackActionIndexMap, and plays attack effect FX_CP_000_23141.

ExtraAttack_1.simple: The character uses a character-specific extra attack.
ExtraAttack_1.technical: This character-specific extra attack uses attack index 18 in GAttackActionIndexMap and a dedicated action object supplied by per-character CreateAction overrides. The base CreateAction switch leaves this slot empty, and character controllers add their own input gates and behavior.
notes: CP_050 and CP_020 create this action for their own techniques.

ExtraAttack_2.simple: The character uses a character-specific extra attack.
ExtraAttack_2.technical: This character-specific extra attack uses attack index 19 in GAttackActionIndexMap and a dedicated action object supplied by per-character CreateAction overrides. The base CreateAction switch leaves this slot empty, and character controllers add their own input gates and behavior.
notes: CP_050 and CP_020 create this action for their own techniques.

DamageDefault.simple: The neutral state for the damage layer.
DamageDefault.technical: The controller selects DamageDefault for the Damage layer on normal characters and ChangeToDefaultActions returns to it. OnActionStarted clears the tag-combo and casual-damage flags when this action starts.

DamageEmpty.simple: An inert Damage-layer action for controlled characters.
DamageEmpty.technical: Control type 5 selects DamageEmpty for the controller Damage-layer default. The class reports the Damage layer and its own action type without adding damage reactions.

Damage.simple: The character staggers from a grounded hit.
Damage.technical: GetDamageReactionAction returns Damage for normal air damage and similar hits when the receiver is not down and has armor available. The action reports priority 100, uses four directional stagger animations, and allows a tag combo through the last attacker.

DamageAir.simple: The character staggers from a hit while airborne.
DamageAir.technical: GetDamageReactionAction returns DamageAir for the default non-down reaction, including SoloSpecialAttack. The class derives from Damage and sets its air-state flag.

Down.technical: GetDamageReactionAction returns Down when damage has no type and the receiver is defeated, and Pick converts many damage types to Down for defeated receivers. The down state advances through rise, landing, ground, and recovery phases with Global Down_Time_Min, Down_Time_Max, or Dead_Time.

DownEnd.simple: The character finishes getting up after being knocked down.
DownEnd.technical: GetDownFollowUpActionType returns DownEnd for a Down reaction when the knocked-up branch conditions are absent. The action shares DownEndBase, plays DownEndFU or DownEndFD, and adds an invincible collision lock on its owner.

Blow.simple: The character is launched by a standard blow.
Blow.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::Blow to this action and can return it early when the receiver has no down value and armor is clear. Blow tracks wall-bound and ground-bound phases and uses BlowEnd as its normal follow-up.

BlowSmall.simple: The character is launched by a small blow.
BlowSmall.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::BlowSmall to this reaction. It uses the Blow family phase logic with its own CanBreakFall and GetDamageComboRate overrides and uses BlowEnd as its follow-up.

BlowLarge.simple: The character is launched by a large blow.
BlowLarge.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::BlowLarge to this reaction. It uses the Blow family phase logic with its own CanBreakFall and GetDamageComboRate overrides and uses BlowEnd as its follow-up.

BlowEnd.simple: The character finishes a blow reaction.
BlowEnd.technical: GetDownFollowUpActionType returns BlowEnd for Blow, BlowSmall, and BlowLarge. It shares DownEndBase animation and invincibility handling with DownEnd and BlowSpinEnd.

BlowSpin.technical: GetDamageReactionAction returns BlowSpin when the receiver has armor clear and DownValue at or below zero, and it maps EGameDamageType::BlowSpin directly. Its launch gravity reads Global BlowSpin_DamageGravity when positive and otherwise reads the request DamageGravity.

BlowSpinEnd.simple: The character finishes a spinning launch.
BlowSpinEnd.technical: GetDownFollowUpActionType returns BlowSpinEnd for BlowSpin, TagComboDamageBlow, and TagComboProjectionSorceryReceiveBlow. It shares the DownEndBase finish animation and collision lock.

BlowGroundRestraint.simple: The character is pinned to the ground after a blow.
BlowGroundRestraint.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::BlowGroundRestraint to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. It uses ground-bound collision handling and its UpdateRequests path keeps the root request processing with no default-move request.

BounceUp.simple: The character bounces upward after a down reaction.
BounceUp.technical: GetDownFollowUpActionType returns BounceUp when there is stick input, status byte 0xDD is 1, the receiver is defeated, and armor ignore is resisted. The action reports priority 100, uses the Default layer, and sets a collision lock on Start.

GroundRestraint.simple: The character is restrained on the ground.
GroundRestraint.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::GroundRestraint to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. Its down wait ends when the damage row RestraintTime has elapsed.

ThrowingRestraint.simple: The character is held for a throw.
ThrowingRestraint.technical: ActionControllerSlot202 calls RequestThrowingRestraint with a location that becomes Request.HitDirection and an ignored-priority request. The action reports priority 100, rejects external force and other characters, and runs the restraint Start and End effects.

ThrowingRestraintCancel.simple: The throw hold on the character is cancelled.
ThrowingRestraintCancel.technical: ActionControllerSlot203 calls RequestThrowingRestraintCancel, which sets a plain default request for this type. Its Start is the cancel half of the throwing-restraint pair and it reports priority 100.

CentipedeRestraint.simple: The character is wrapped in a centipede-style restraint.
CentipedeRestraint.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::CentipedeRestraint to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. The restraint effect spawns on Start, and external force and other characters are accepted once Phase is above zero.

CentipedeRestraintFall.simple: The character is wrapped and then dropped.
CentipedeRestraintFall.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::CentipedeRestraintFall to this action. Tick swings the body pitch until the damage row RestraintTime, fades the restraint effect from 1 to 0 over 0.3 seconds, offsets the effect by minus 100, 0, and 100 world units, rotates it by 10 degrees, then applies the CN_122 follow-up damage.

CrimsonBindingRestraint.simple: The character is held by a crimson binding.
CrimsonBindingRestraint.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::CrimsonBindingRestraint to this action. A waist binding effect uses FX_CP_190_06201 and releases with the binding, while the restraint effect uses FX_CP_190_06203 and spawns after the initial phase.

UnlimitedVoidReceive.simple: The character is caught in Unlimited Void.
UnlimitedVoidReceive.technical: DomainExpansion Sub7 selects SetActionType_Ally or SetActionType_Enemy by team and calls ChangeAction for non-None values. The receive action plays its animation until Global UnlimitedVoidReceive_Time elapses and also puts the owner shikigami into its matching receive action.
notes: Exported CP_050 domain rows use this type for both ally and enemy targets.

CoercionReceive.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::Coercion to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. The action reports priority 50, disables replacement, and plays the CoercionReceive animation.

JugonStunReceive.simple: The character is stunned by Jugon.
JugonStunReceive.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::JugonStun to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. It reports priority 50 and plays the shared JugonStunReceive animation while Tick advances its timed state.

SimpleDomainCounterStunReceive.simple: The character is stunned by a simple-domain counter.
SimpleDomainCounterStunReceive.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::SimpleDomainCounterStun to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. It reports priority 50 and plays the same JugonStunReceive animation through its own Start.

ProjectionSorceryReceive.simple: The character is frozen in a Projection Sorcery frame.
ProjectionSorceryReceive.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::ProjectionSorcery to this action unless the receiver has no next parallel attack, which resolves to DamageAir or Down. The frame uses FX_CP_270_00311, 0.01 animation rate, and mesh scale Y of 0.01, and a damaging hit of 10 non-lethal hit points breaks it with FX_CP_270_00411.

ProjectionSorceryReceiveBlow.simple: The character is frozen in mid-launch by Projection Sorcery.
ProjectionSorceryReceiveBlow.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::ProjectionSorceryBlow to this action and resolves to Down when no next parallel attack is available. It freezes BlowSpin launch inside FX_CP_270_00311 with phases 0 and 1, and break fall becomes available at phase 2.

FreezingRestraint.simple: The character is locked in a freezing restraint.
FreezingRestraint.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::FreezingRestraint to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. It spawns FX_CN_250_00401 with the owner effect offset and scale, and the JugonStunReceive animation is reused.

ClashingDamage.simple: The character staggers from a clash.
ClashingDamage.technical: When an opposing character clashing hit box contacts collision channel 6, AGameCharacter::ColParamSlot3 sets a request for this action. It derives from the damage-reaction family and reports priority 100.

TagComboDamage.simple: The character takes a tag-combo hit.
TagComboDamage.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::TagCombo to this action and Pick turns it into Down for defeated receivers. OnActionStarted sets bTagComboDamageAction for the five tag-combo reaction types. Its phases are 0 slow, 1 wait for collision lock 4, and 2 release.

TagComboDamageBlow.simple: The character takes a tag-combo launch.
TagComboDamageBlow.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::TagComboBlow to this action. It combines BlowSpin launch with tag-combo phases 0 slow, 1 wait for collision lock 4, and 2 release, with break fall available at phase 3.

TagComboCentipedeRestraint.simple: The character is wrapped in a tag-combo centipede restraint.
TagComboCentipedeRestraint.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::TagComboCentipedeRestraint to this action. It uses the restraint-effect base with tag-combo phases, accepts external force and other characters after Phase 2, and sets bTagComboDamageAction.

TagComboProjectionSorceryReceive.simple: The character is frozen in a tag-combo Projection Sorcery frame.
TagComboProjectionSorceryReceive.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::TagComboProjectionSorcery to this action, with Down for defeated receivers and TagComboDamage when no next parallel attack is present. It uses Projection Sorcery freeze with the slow, pair, and release phases of TagComboDamage.

TagComboProjectionSorceryReceiveBlow.simple: The character is frozen in a tag-combo Projection Sorcery launch.
TagComboProjectionSorceryReceiveBlow.technical: GetDamageReactionAction maps EGameDamageType::TagComboProjectionSorceryBlow to this action, with Down for defeated receivers and TagComboDamageBlow when no next parallel attack is present. Its phases are 0 slow, 1 pair, and 2 release, with break fall from phase 3.

ItemEffectPenalty.simple: The character is penalized by an item effect on the ground.
ItemEffectPenalty.technical: ProcessRequests adds this penalty when an accepted attack request has an item-effect penalty and the pending action reports IsGrounded false. The action derives from DamageReaction and reports priority 50.

ItemEffectPenaltyAir.simple: The character is penalized by an item effect in the air.
ItemEffectPenaltyAir.technical: ProcessRequests adds this penalty when an accepted attack request has an item-effect penalty and the pending action reports IsGrounded true. The class derives from the item penalty action and sets its air-state flag.

BindingVowsPenalty.simple: The character is penalized for breaking a binding vow on the ground.
BindingVowsPenalty.technical: RequestBindingVowsPenalty adds this type for RunBegin with run vows, NormalDashBegin with the dash vow, Guard with GuardCount, Step with step or dash vows, and NormalAttack follow-ups with SpecialTagComboCount.

BindingVowsPenaltyAir.simple: The character is penalized for breaking a binding vow in the air.
BindingVowsPenaltyAir.technical: RequestBindingVowsPenalty adds this type for air dash begins with the dash vow, GuardAir with GuardCount, StepAir with step or dash vows, all jump begins with jump vows, and special tag-combo follow-ups with SpecialTagComboCount.

Num.simple: The enum uses this entry as the action count.
Num.technical: Num equals the number of indexed action slots. Init sizes the Actions array to Num and CreateAction fills one slot per value below that count, so Num never names an action object.
notes: Num is a boundary marker for the indexed action slots.

Invalid.simple: The enum uses this entry when no action applies.
Invalid.technical: Invalid is the 255 sentinel returned by base action GetActionType and GetAutoComboActionType. Damage reaction selection, item penalties, and binding-vow penalties use it to mean that no request should be added.
notes: Invalid is outside the Actions array because Init only creates slots below Num.
The controller uses the enum value directly as an index into its Actions array, which is sized to Num during Init.
Attack values share cancel tables, start counts, ground and air conversion maps, and an attack index map used by attack transition kinds.
The base CreateAction switch has no objects for Floating, ExtraAttack_1, or ExtraAttack_2, so character controllers supply those actions.
Exported CharacterDataTable rows use this enum for AutoAttackDash_NextActionType, and exported DomainExpansionDataTable rows use it for SetActionType_Enemy and SetActionType_Ally.
Request parsing, guard selection, guard-break selection, and damage reaction selection are the traced consumers that give these values their runtime meaning.
